events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Mary Tuthill (b. 1687, d. 1780), daughter of John Tuthill Jr & Mehitable Wells; six children Mary, Eliphaz, Mehitable, Azariah, Lazarus, Ambrose (b. 1708-20). [R4-S1]

bio: Son of Capt. Jonathan Horton (first captain of Suffolk County's first cavalry company) and Bethia, daughter of William Wells ([R4-S2]). So he is himself John's blood cousin: William Wells -> Bethia -> Jonathan, 1st cousin 10 times removed (and 1C11R via Barnabas Horton if the Rachel Browne line holds). His wife Mary Tuthill is John's 9th-great-grandaunt.
sources: [R4-S1] Lucy D. Akerly, The Tuthill Family of Tharston, Norfolk Co., England, and Southold, Suffolk Co., New York (1898) (archive.org full text), p. 8 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/tuthillfamilyoft00aker

[R4-S2] George F. Horton, Horton Genealogy, or Chronicles of the Descendants of Barnabas Horton (1876) (archive.org full text), pp. 11-12 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/hortongenealogyo00hort
